import sys

MAX_SIZE = 2345678

def main():
    input = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    total_real = int(input[0])
    max_k_value = int(input[1])
    prob_real = list(map(float, input[2:2+total_real]))

    prob = []
    idx = []
    for i in range(total_real):
        if prob_real[i] > 1e-4:
            idx.append(i)
            prob.append(prob_real[i])
    valid_count = len(prob)
    max_k_value = min(max_k_value, valid_count)

    bits_count = [0] * (1 << valid_count)
    for mask in range(1, 1 << valid_count):
        bits_count[mask] = bits_count[mask & (mask - 1)] + 1

    dp_array = [0.0] * (1 << valid_count)
    result_arr = [0.0] * total_real

    dp_array[0] = 1.0

    for mask in range(1 << valid_count):
        if bits_count[mask] == max_k_value:
            for j in range(valid_count):
                if mask & (1 << j):
                    result_arr[idx[j]] += dp_array[mask]
            continue
        total_prob = 0.0
        for j in range(valid_count):
            if mask & (1 << j):
                continue
            total_prob += prob[j]
        if total_prob == 0:
            continue
        ratio = dp_array[mask] / total_prob
        for j in range(valid_count):
            if mask & (1 << j):
                continue
            dp_array[mask | (1 << j)] += prob[j] * ratio

    print(' '.join(f"{x:.17f}" for x in result_arr))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
